feature: COUNT, MIN and MAX aggregates over a labelled node-only scan

scenarios.name: COUNT over a node-only scan is one row
scenarios.inspired_by: opencypher TCK — expressions/aggregation (aggregates over a single-label scan: count, min, max, grouping, empty input)

scenarios.name: MIN, MAX and COUNT together over a node-only scan are one row
scenarios.inspired_by: opencypher TCK — expressions/aggregation (aggregates over a single-label scan: count, min, max, grouping, empty input)
scenarios.query: MATCH (a:grid_fixtures__node) RETURN MIN(a.data.severity_score) AS lowest, MAX(a.data.severity_score) AS highest, MIN(a.data.observed_at) AS first_seen, MAX(a.data.observed_at) AS last_seen, COUNT(a) AS alerts

scenarios.name: grouped node-only aggregation: one row per scanner
scenarios.inspired_by: opencypher TCK — expressions/aggregation (aggregates over a single-label scan: count, min, max, grouping, empty input)
scenarios.query: MATCH (a:grid_fixtures__node) RETURN a.data.kind AS scanner, COUNT(a) AS alerts, MAX(a.data.severity_score) AS highest, MIN(a.data.observed_at) AS first_seen ORDER BY scanner

scenarios.name: ORDER BY an aggregate with LIMIT over a node-only scan
scenarios.inspired_by: opencypher TCK — expressions/aggregation (aggregates over a single-label scan: count, min, max, grouping, empty input)
scenarios.query: MATCH (a:grid_fixtures__node) RETURN a.data.kind AS scanner, COUNT(a) AS alerts ORDER BY alerts DESC LIMIT 1

scenarios.name: WHERE narrows the scan before the aggregate
scenarios.inspired_by: opencypher TCK — expressions/aggregation (aggregates over a single-label scan: count, min, max, grouping, empty input)
scenarios.query: MATCH (a:grid_fixtures__node) WHERE a.data.kind = "scanner-y" RETURN MIN(a.data.severity_score) AS lowest, MAX(a.data.observed_at) AS last_seen

scenarios.name: an aggregate over an empty node-only scan is one row: COUNT 0, MAX null
scenarios.inspired_by: opencypher TCK — expressions/aggregation (aggregates over a single-label scan: count, min, max, grouping, empty input)
scenarios.query: MATCH (a:grid_fixtures__node) WHERE a.data.severity_score > 100 RETURN COUNT(a) AS alerts, MAX(a.data.severity_score) AS highest

scenarios.name: MIN of a field that is NULL on every matched node is null
scenarios.inspired_by: opencypher TCK — expressions/aggregation (aggregates over a single-label scan: count, min, max, grouping, empty input)
scenarios.query: MATCH (a:grid_fixtures__node) WHERE a.data.severity_score < 5 RETURN MIN(a.data.observed_at) AS first_seen

scenarios.name: an aggregate over a labelless scan is refused
scenarios.inspired_by: opencypher TCK — expressions/aggregation (refused aggregate shapes over a scan)

scenarios.name: an aggregate over two MATCH clauses is refused
scenarios.inspired_by: opencypher TCK — expressions/aggregation (refused aggregate shapes over a scan)
scenarios.query: MATCH (a:grid_fixtures__node) MATCH (b:grid_fixtures__leaf) RETURN COUNT(a) AS n

scenarios.name: an aggregate on a variable the scan does not bind is refused
scenarios.inspired_by: opencypher TCK — expressions/aggregation (refused aggregate shapes over a scan)

scenarios.name: a bare scanned variable cannot be a group key
scenarios.inspired_by: opencypher TCK — expressions/aggregation (refused aggregate shapes over a scan)
scenarios.query: MATCH (a:grid_fixtures__node) RETURN a, COUNT(a) AS n

scenarios.name: COUNT of a deep path is refused
scenarios.inspired_by: opencypher TCK — expressions/aggregation (refused aggregate shapes over a scan)

scenarios.name: MAX of a plain string field is refused over a scan too
scenarios.inspired_by: opencypher TCK — expressions/aggregation (refused aggregate shapes over a scan)

scenarios.inspired_by: opencypher TCK — expressions/aggregation (refused aggregate shapes over a scan)
